messages:
laura_cs: FYI, Blue Harbor Clinics (cust_9901) opened a billing dispute for INV-2026-0450 - they were charged an unexpected overage of $3,250 after a daily sync spike on 2026-04-02. Can finance take a look for a manual adjustment?

matt_fin: Can you attach the usage breakout and any evidence that shows duplicates vs legitimate traffic? we need the window + sample ids for audit.

laura_cs: Uploaded a short csv to the ticket (CS-2207) and pasted a snippet: ```bash
# sample from usage_export.csv
event_hash,occurrences,ts
8f3b21,4,2026-04-02T11:07:32Z
14a9d0,3,2026-04-02T11:09:10Z
...
```
looks like many event_hashes show >1 occurrence within seconds. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-2207

aditya_ops: Investigated — vendor CDC connector emitted duplicate batches because our connector checkpoint failed during a transient DB failover at 11:06 UTC. Checkpoint write retried but our dedupe window was temporarily disabled by a rollback. Logs: `cdc-connector WARN checkpoint rollback at 2026-04-02T11:06:45Z`. This was platform-side.

aditya_ops: Repro log excerpt: ```
cdc-connector ERROR 2026-04-02T11:06:45Z: checkpoint write failed: timeout
cdc-connector INFO 2026-04-02T11:06:46Z: retrying batch, dedupe disabled temporarily
```

matt_fin: Since this is platform-induced duplicate ingestion, recommend refunding duplicated usage. How much to credit?

laura_cs: From the export, duplicates map to $3,000 of the overage. I propose crediting $3,000 as an invoice adjustment + $250 as a courtesy promo for churn risk = $3,250 total.

matt_fin: Please confirm GL code and escalate to finance lead for approval. I'll prep the credit memo once approved. Recommend GL account `4500-credits-billing`.

laura_cs: GL noted. @emma_cfo can you review the evidence and approve?

emma_cfo: Reviewed CS-2207 and ops logs. Approve manual credit of $3,250 (full overage) for Blue Harbor Clinics. Proceed and add memo referencing CS-2207 and platform incident. :white_check_mark:

matt_fin: Creating manual credit memo now.

billing-bot: Manual credit created:
- credit_id: CR-2026-4410
- amount: $3,250
- applied_to: INV-2026-0450
- status: PENDING_POSTING

matt_fin: Credit queued to accounting; posting ETA 1 business day. Note: reason = duplicate ingestion during CDC connector checkpoint rollback (ops ticket OP-498).

laura_cs: I'll update the customer with the credit memo once posted. Thanks all. :pray:

billing-bot: CR-2026-4410 status changed -> POSTED. Transaction ref: tx_b7e45a. Link: https://billing.redwood.com/credits/CR-2026-4410.pdf
